# Shop upgrades

Upgrade cards are bought with points during a run and are gone when the run ends. There are **51 cards** in 4 tiers. Bigger shops deal higher tiers, see [the shop](basics.md#the-shop).

The 1st, 2nd and 3rd columns are the price of each copy before Haggler. "Copies from your tree" in a card means copies the [meta tree](meta-tree.md) gives you at the start of a run.

Dealt in the Basic, Advanced, Elite shops.

| ⬛ Dark Tiles +2 | Dark tiles are worth +2 points. | 20 | 160 | 540 |  |
| ✨ All Tiles +1 | Every tile is worth +1 point, whatever its colour. | 30 | 240 | 810 |  |
